product_one_liner.value: Ordway automates quote-to-cash—including subscription and usage-based billing, invoicing, payment collection, and revenue management—for recurring-revenue businesses such as SaaS, cloud, and fintech companies.

pricing_page.notes: The company directs prospects to request a proposal rather than presenting public pricing; the homepage does not show a pricing-page link.

employee_band.notes: A company profile listed 64 employees, within this band.

eng_blog.notes: The inspected blog-index pages show business, product, and finance education posts rather than at least two engineering-authored posts about building the product.

public_docs.notes: Ordway publicly provides a categorized help center and an API documentation portal.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page lists Product Manager – AI Finance among current openings.

model_provider.notes: Ordway names Claude as a connected assistant; it does not identify the model provider behind its own built-in AI features.

compliance_certs.notes: Ordway says it is SOC 2 audited and names GDPR; no other requested items are claimed on that page.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers page lists an Account Executive opening, and a job listing dated November 7, 2026 also advertised the role.
